item.title: Turkey Tracks Shooting Area remains closed this week due to fire danger
item.description: The Turkey Tracks Shooting Area will remain closed for at least another week as another round of Red Flag Warnings and high fire danger makes its way into southern Colorado.

item.title: Freezing water, a sinking car and seconds to act: Inside the Prospect Lake rescue
item.description: Colorado Springs firefighters rescued a person trapped inside a vehicle that sank into Prospect Lake, braving freezing water to break open the car's sunroof and pull the victim to safety.

item.title: UCCS Radio wins 2026 Best Streaming-Only Station Award
item.description: UCCS Radio, the student-run streaming station at the University of Colorado Colorado Springs, has won the 2026 Best Streaming-Only Station Award from the Intercollegiate Broadcasting System.
